comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Outsourced services provider paid a revenue share by partner universities; it doesn't operate institutions or collect tuition directly.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Operates for-profit allied health and nursing colleges funded by tuition and student aid, like Rasmussen, though smaller and regional.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Operates for-profit, mostly online universities for adult students funded by Title IV tuition, including health sciences programs.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Operates online and campus universities for working adults, with military and employer tuition channels and Title IV funding.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mainly K-12 virtual schools funded by public per-pupil funding, a different customer base and regulation than adult higher education.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Operates for-profit postsecondary career and technical schools funded by tuition, Title IV and GI Bill, though campus-only and trades-focused.
